suite.title: Test Suite
suite.message:
A suite is a named folder that groups related tests together — for example, all tests for your login page.

You can run an entire suite at once.

test.title: Test
test.message:
A test is a single script that checks one thing — like 'can a user log in?'.

It has a name, a starting URL, and a list of recorded steps.

recording.title: Recording
recording.message:
When you press Record, a browser opens and every click, keystroke, and navigation you make is captured automatically as a step.

No code needed.

running.title: Running a Test
running.message:
When you press Run, Ruby Raider opens the browser and replays every recorded step automatically.

It then tells you whether the test passed or failed.

steps.title: Recorded Steps
steps.message:
Steps are the individual actions in a test — things like 'click button', 'type text', or 'visit URL'.

You can reorder, edit, or delete steps at any time.

overview.title: Project Overview
overview.message:
The Overview is your project's home.

Browse files on the left, preview them on the right, and use the toolbar to set your browser, run mode, and test timeout.

recording.title: Recording a Test
recording.message:
Pick a suite from the dropdown, create a test, and enter the URL you want to test.

Then press the red Record button — a browser will open and every click or keystroke you make is captured as a step.

Press Stop when you're done, then Run to check if the test passes.

dashboard.title: Recording Dashboard
dashboard.message:
The dashboard shows the output from your last test run — which steps passed, which failed, and any error messages.

Use it to understand what went wrong and decide what to fix or re-record.

tests.title: Tests
tests.message:
Every test in your project is listed here.

Recorded tests were made with the recorder — click Edit to change them.

Code tests were written by a developer, and Code-owned tests were recorded and then changed by hand. You can view and run them, but only a developer can change them.

files.title: Files & Test Settings
files.message:
Browse all files in your project on the left — click any file to preview it on the right.

Use the toolbar above to set which browser to use, whether to run headlessly, which tests to run, and the timeout.

These settings apply every time you run your tests.

scaffold.title: Scaffolding
scaffold.message:
Scaffolding generates boilerplate files for you — page objects, spec files, feature files, and helpers.

Fill in the form and Ruby Raider will create the right file structure so you can start writing test logic immediately without setting things up by hand.

dashboard.title: Project Dashboard
dashboard.message:
The dashboard gives you an at-a-glance view of your project's test health — total tests, recent pass/fail trends, and run history.

Use it to track quality over time without having to run tests manually.

createProject.title: Create a New Project
createProject.message:
Choose your automation framework (Selenium is the most common for web apps), your test style (RSpec or Cucumber), and give your project a name.

Ruby Raider will generate a ready-to-use folder structure for you.

landing.title: Welcome to Ruby Raider
landing.message:
Ruby Raider is a visual test automation tool.

Use Quick record to record a website as a test without a project, the Overview's Tests tab to record, browse and run your project's tests, or Create Project to start a brand new test suite from scratch.

For installation help and a full guide, click the Ruby Raider logo in the top-left corner of the app.

tooltips.viewTrace: View the step-by-step trace for this test — see screenshots and element info for every recorded action.

recorder.newTest: Create a new blank test inside the active suite. Give it a name and a URL, then press Record.
recorder.implicitWait: Seconds Selenium automatically waits for a page element to appear before giving up. 0 means no automatic wait.
recorder.explicitWait: Maximum seconds to wait for a specific condition — such as a button becoming clickable.
recorder.deleteStep: Remove this step from the test. The remaining steps will still run in order.
recorder.dragStep: Drag to reorder this step. Tests run steps from top to bottom.
recorder.setBreakpoint: Set a breakpoint here — click 'Record from here' to replay steps up to this point headlessly, then continue recording from this page state.

overview.urlInput: The base URL used when running your tests — e.g. https://staging.example.com
overview.browserSelect: Which browser to launch when running tests. Chrome is the most widely supported.
overview.headlessToggle: Headless mode runs the browser invisibly in the background — faster, but you won't see what's happening on screen.
overview.runMode: Choose which tests to run: all of them, only smoke tests, regression tests, or a custom tag.
overview.rerunFailed: Re-run only the tests that failed in the last run — useful for quickly confirming a fix.
overview.timeout: Maximum seconds a single test can take before it is automatically marked as failed.
